summary: Second full 17-hunter pass on Mozilla staging pontoon. Zero bounty-eligible (High/Critical qualifying) findings. Several genuine Medium-class privacy/PII issues confirmed but NON-qualifying because Mozilla only pays High/Critical.

validated_findings.description: Unauthenticated bulk PII disclosure: returns full email + user ID + display name + role for EVERY contributor of any project+locale. 127 emails (fr/firefox), 154 (de/firefox). View has @require_AJAX only, no @login_required. Bypasses opaque-username identity-hiding.
validated_findings.evidence: 200 JSON with authors[].email / id / display_name / role
validated_findings.reproduction: curl -x http://localhost:8088 --proxy-insecure -k -A 'BountyGrimoire/1.0 (Security Research; HackerOne: mozilla program)' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' 'https://pontoon.allizom.org/fr/firefox/all-resources/authors-and-time-range/'
validated_findings.notes: Real privacy bug, worth reporting for a fix; no payout (Medium).

validated_findings.description: Unauthenticated translation-history endpoint leaks submitter email + username + uid for any sequentially-enumerable entity ID. Reveals internal usernames differing from public opaque slugs.
validated_findings.reproduction: curl -x http://localhost:8088 --proxy-insecure -k -A 'BountyGrimoire/1.0 (Security Research; HackerOne: mozilla program)' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' 'https://pontoon.allizom.org/get-history/?entity=58337&locale=fr'

validated_findings.description: Public leaderboard renders raw account email as display name when user has no display name (name_or_email fallback); also leaks email in Gravatar d= URL.
validated_findings.reproduction: curl -x http://localhost:8088 --proxy-insecure -k -A 'BountyGrimoire/1.0 (Security Research; HackerOne: mozilla program)' https://pontoon.allizom.org/contributors/
validated_findings.notes: Real bug, 2+ emails confirmed; no payout (Medium).

validated_findings.description: Profile page exposes internal Django PK via data-user attribute unauthenticated.
validated_findings.reproduction: curl -x http://localhost:8088 --proxy-insecure -k -A 'BountyGrimoire/1.0 (Security Research; HackerOne: mozilla program)' 'https://pontoon.allizom.org/contributors/TheoChevalier/'

discarded.reason: NOT_REPRODUCIBLE — FXA redirect_uri stayed canonical; FXA rejects unregistered redirect_uris. Original hunter over-reported Medium.
FALSE_POSITIVE — registered and unregistered emails both return 404, no oracle.
Global PM-only perm is residual-by-design; requires PM privileges, cosmetic; Informational.
Public OpenAPI for open-source project; Low/Info, intentional.

bounty_eligible: NONE — every confirmed finding is Medium or below; Mozilla program pays High/Critical only.
suggested_action: The two strongest real issues (authors-and-time-range AND get-history unauthenticated email/uid disclosure) are legitimate Medium privacy findings. Not bounty-eligible, but worth reporting to Mozilla as quality/security disclosures for a fix. If seeking payout, pivot to a different in-scope target (e.g. accounts.firefox.com which has real High-severity IDOR history) or pursue authenticated testing on pontoon with a test FxA staging account to reach auth-gated surfaces.
